scripts.title: build a boat for tresure
scripts.features: auto farm
scripts.script:
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jensonhirst/Orion/main/source')))()

function autofarmstart()
    local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    local tweenInfoE = TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    local AutofarmInfoS = TweenInfo.new(24, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)

    local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local Tween = tweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = CFrame.new(-53.3258858, 61.0841904, -168.990448)})
    Tween:Play()
    Tween.Completed:Wait()

    local TweenS = tweenService:Create(hrp, AutofarmInfoS, {CFrame = CFrame.new(-60.1640434, 45.5146027, 8749.81738)})
    TweenS:Play()
    TweenS.Completed:Wait()

    local TweenE = tweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfoE, {CFrame = CFrame.new(-54.7364044, -352.343506, 9499.69141)}) -- Hauteur ajustée
    TweenE:Play()

    wait(2)
    hrp.Anchored = true

    spawn(function()
        local startTime = tick() -- Enregistre le temps de début
        while game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character do
            wait()
            -- Positionne le joueur juste au-dessus du trésor
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(-54.7364044, -351.343506, 9499.69141) -- 1m au-dessus
            firetouchinterest(hrp, game:GetService("Workspace").BoatStages.NormalStages.TheEnd.GoldenChest.Trigger, 0)
            wait(0.1)
            firetouchinterest(hrp, game:GetService("Workspace").BoatStages.NormalStages.TheEnd.GoldenChest.Trigger, 1)

            -- Vérifie si bloqué (si ça fait plus de 10 secondes sans obtenir le trésor, on reset)
            if tick() - startTime > 10 then
                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:BreakJoints() -- Reset le joueur
                return
            end
        end
    end)
end

local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "Build a Boat for Treasure", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "OrionBuildBoat"})

local AutoFarmTab = Window:MakeTab({
    Name = "Autofarm",
    Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998",
    PremiumOnly = false
})

local AutofarmSection = AutoFarmTab:AddSection({
    Name = "Autofarm"
})

local autofarm = nil
game.Workspace.Gravity = 0.5

AutofarmSection:AddToggle({
    Name = "Autofarm",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(t)
        autofarm = t
        if autofarm then
            autofarmstart()
        end
    end
})

game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not autofarm then return end
    autofarmstart()
end)

OrionLib:Init()

scripts.script:
-- GUI oluşturuluyor
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local KodAraButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local AramaKutusu = Instance.new("TextBox")
local CalistirButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local KapatButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- GUI'nin ekran üzerine eklenmesi
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Frame ayarları
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Kod Ara butonu
KodAraButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
KodAraButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 50)
KodAraButton.Text = "Kod Ara"
KodAraButton.Parent = Frame

-- Arama Kutusu (Başta gizli)
AramaKutusu.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 50)
AramaKutusu.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 120)
AramaKutusu.PlaceholderText = "Kodunuzu buraya yazın"
AramaKutusu.Visible = false
AramaKutusu.Parent = Frame

-- Çalıştır butonu
CalistirButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
CalistirButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0, 190)
CalistirButton.Text = "Çalıştır"
CalistirButton.Parent = Frame

-- Kapat butonu
KapatButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
KapatButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0, 250)
KapatButton.Text = "Kapat"
KapatButton.Parent = Frame

-- Kod Ara butonuna tıklanınca arama kutusunu görünür yap
KodAraButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    AramaKutusu.Visible = true
end)

-- Çalıştır butonuna tıklanınca yazılan kodu çalıştır
CalistirButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local kod = AramaKutusu.Text
    if kod ~= "" then
        loadstring(kod)()  -- Kullanıcıdan alınan kodu çalıştır
    else
        warn("Kod boş olamaz!")
    end
end)

-- Kapat butonuna tıklanınca GUI'yi kapat
KapatButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

}


local replacementAnimations = {

    ["10469643643"] = "rbxassetid://13532562418",

    ["10469630950"] = "rbxassetid://13532600125",

    ["10469493270"] = "rbxassetid://13532562418",

}


local queue = {}

local isAnimating = false


local function playReplacementAnimation(animationId)

    if isAnimating then

        table.insert(queue, animationId)

        return

    end

   

    isAnimating = true

    local replacementAnimationId = replacementAnimations[tostring(animationId)]

    if replacementAnimationId then

        local AnimAnim = Instance.new("Animation")

        AnimAnim.AnimationId = replacementAnimationId

        local Anim = humanoid:LoadAnimation(AnimAnim)

        Anim:Play()

       

        Anim.Stopped:Connect(function()

            isAnimating = false

            if #queue > 0 then

                local nextAnimationId = table.remove(queue, 1)

                playReplacementAnimation(nextAnimationId)

            end

        end)

    else

        isAnimating = false

    end

end


local function stopSpecificAnimations()

    for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do

        local animationId = tonumber(track.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+"))

        end

    end

end


local function onAnimationPlayed(animationTrack)

        stopSpecificAnimations()

end
